response.original_title: Aquarius: The Skin Game / The Case of Jean-Luc Godard
response.overview: Jean-Luc Godard was commissioned by London Weekend Television (LWT) to make "British Sounds." The film was subsequently banned, but LWT nevertheless for a arranged a private screening of the film to be held at the Institute of Contemporary Arts (ICA). The post-screening debate was recorded and aired along with brief clips from the film for the very first episode of the British arts television series Aquarius, hosted by Humphrey Burton.
